title: Renew request (input, contract v0)
description: A request to agentspace lease renew. The v0 CLI takes it as flags and arguments only and never reads this document; it defines the request for validation, and for the hosted API (#0011), which takes it as JSON. Tolerant in form (any case, surrounding whitespace, null for not given) and strict in meaning. The TTL's range, 1 minute to 24 hours, is checked after parsing, not here. See docs/lease-api.md.

id.description: The lease ID: a UUIDv4 in any case.

ttl.description: A duration with units. Null or absent means the lease's current ttl_seconds.

Short form (8h, 90m, 1h30m, '2 hours'; units d, h and s in any case and m in lowercase only, or their words in any case, largest first, each once, with optional whitespace between and around them) or ISO 8601 P[nD][T[nH][nM][nS]] in any case. A bare number, an uppercase M in the short form, weeks, months, years and fractions are refused.
